reply.text:
This is a pain question, so I won't assess it or reassure you about it. Hip aching is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I'd get it looked at before we decide what to train around it.

Once you have a clear answer on what's safe, tell me what to avoid and I'll build the training around it. Removing sumo deadlifts from your program is something I can do for you, so say the word and I'll set that change up for you to confirm in the app.
